title: Picasso plugin registry manifest
description: Structure of index.json, the manifest Picasso reads to list, install and update plugins. Additional properties are allowed on purpose, so a new optional field does not break older Picasso clients.

schema.description: Manifest format version. Bump only for a breaking change to this structure.

id.description: Stable identifier. Becomes the file name (<id>.py) in the user's plugins folder, so it must not contain path characters. Changing it orphans existing installs.

display_name.description: Name shown in Picasso's plugin browser.

app.description: The Picasso GUI this plugin adds actions to.

description.description: One or two sentences shown in the plugin browser. State any hardware or dependency requirement here.

author.description: Who wrote and maintains the plugin.

file.description: Relative path to the plugin source inside this repository. Forward slashes, no '..', must end in .py.

version.description: Plugin version. Must increase whenever the file's bytes change, otherwise existing users are never offered the update.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the exact bytes of 'file'. Picasso refuses to install an entry whose hash is missing or does not match. Regenerate with tools/hash_plugins.py --update.

min_picasso_version.description: Oldest Picasso release this plugin works with. Older clients list it as incompatible instead of failing at import time.
